detail.longDescription:
The current landscape of #libreSoftware development and the effects of #machineLearning on it make me question if I want to keep doing this.

I have made some friends by making #Liblast for these 6 years.

I have contributed substantially by reporting bugs to #Godot 4 engine's pre-alpha development.

I have made a lot of code, art and designs that I'm proud of.

I have made some unforgettable memories playing Liblast with friends.

But...

Maybe it's just time to move on?

- unfa
